name: What factors influence the valuation of a waterfront home?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the valuation of a waterfront home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several key factors determine the value of a waterfront home. These include the type of water frontage (ocean, bay, canal, lake), view quality, direct water access, and the depth/usability for boats. Additionally, the condition and features of the home, lot size, seawall condition, and recent comparable sales of other waterfront properties in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Collier, or Orange County play a significant role. The specific micro-location within these areas can also greatly impact perceived value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors like water frontage type, view, access, home condition, lot size, seawall, and comparable sales influence waterfront home valuations.
